entities.name: NR sidelink discovery
entities.description: Procedure for device discovery in NR sidelink communication between UEs without network infrastructure.

entities.name: Discovery message
entities.description: Message used in NR sidelink discovery procedure for announcing or monitoring discovery information.

entities.name: Discovery resource pool
entities.description: Set of time-frequency resources configured for NR sidelink discovery transmissions.

relations.description: NR sidelink discovery procedure involves transmission and reception of discovery messages.
NR sidelink discovery procedure requires configuration of discovery resource pools for operation.
Discovery messages are transmitted using resources from the configured discovery resource pool.
